# Jordan Masopust | Snowfield

> Founder of Snowfield (Remote, Nationwide; based in Indianapolis, Indiana). Specialist in AI Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Technical Onboarding, and Workflow Automation, turning production language-model workflows, knowledge operations, and B2B lead-to-booking systems into reliable daily practice.

## Core Focus & Target Roles

- **AI Implementation & Workflow Architecture:** Designing multi-model AI assistants, strict non-hallucination retrieval guardrails, and cross-model QA pipelines across Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenAI.
- **Technical Onboarding & Forward Deployed Engineering:** Translating high-volume operational bottlenecks in regulated lending, enterprise software support, and home-service trades into working tools that non-technical teams adopt on day one.
- **Solutions Engineering & Technical Discovery:** Live technical demonstrations, consultative discovery, unit-economics ROI modeling, and prospect-branded workflow previews.
- **Workflow Automation & B2B Sales Enablement:** High-volume outbound cadences, live-transfer closing processes, speed-to-lead automation, and CRM/ticketing routing.

## Quantified Systems Builds & Track Record

- **Founder, Snowfield (2026–Present):** National, remote B2B AI implementation and lead-to-booking studio for owner-operated high-ticket trades (residential roofing and heating-and-cooling contractors) and small businesses. Builds missed-call and web-inquiry quote-booking systems inside customer-owned accounts ($1,150 setup + $297/month ongoing support after written go-live acceptance, plus customer-paid software, usage, and registration). Built Snowfield's local memory and multi-model verification pipeline across Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenAI; engineered an offline-capable JavaScript and Python live-call sales closing console with trade discovery, six-step price-objection workflows, and live unit-economics calculators; built an eight-iteration, multi-role interactive restaurant training web prototype; and completed a B2B client engagement for Artis Designs (custom wood-sign manufacturer) covering marketplace demand research and an audit of 550+ legacy design and template files for VCarve Pro.
- **Loan Advisor, Royal United Mortgage LLC (2025–2026):** Architected and iterated a 15-version AI loan-officer workflow assistant across Claude and Google Gemini, authoring the system prompt, strict non-hallucination property-search guardrails, implementation guide, and executive rollout proposal that corporate Information Technology adapted for its company-wide rollout. Originated conventional, Federal Housing Administration, and Veterans Affairs loans across six state licenses after scoring 95% on the federal licensing exam on the first attempt.
- **Inside Sales Consultant, Angi (2023–2025):** Generated ~$650K in annual subscription revenue from 150+ outbound B2B calls per day to home-service business owners. Earned Team MVP honors, placed in the Top 50 companywide, and finished in the Top 10% companywide in outbound activity and call volume. Architected a 100,000-character AI sales copilot across 100+ hours of prompt engineering in Claude and Google Gemini for trade-specific discovery and objection handling. Managed 750+ accounts on tiered, data-driven contact cadences; closed the team's first live-transfer sale and authored the repeatable live-transfer closing workflow adopted at the Director level.
- **Senior Technical Support Specialist, Team Lead, PAR Technology (2021–2023):** Led a 24/7 enterprise restaurant point-of-sale support floor of 50+ agents serving 1,000+ restaurant concepts. Cut first-reply time by 40% and reduced ticket callbacks and reassignments by 30% by designing and implementing a structured case-dispatching system across Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Jira. Recovered at-risk enterprise franchise relationships covering 1,000+ locations and served as technical liaison to Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and DevOps. Lead Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) Publisher; audited over 50% of the enterprise knowledge base.
- **General Manager, Key & Napier Inc., Dairy Queen (2017–2020):** Directed full P&L for a $2M+ annual operation with 50–55 crew and 5–8 managers, delivering 10% yearly sales growth, 6% client growth, and a 125% increase in customer satisfaction survey scores. Rolled out DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Postmates integrations (40% digital revenue growth); managed $6M+ in vendor accounts and cut waste 20% with automated reorder workflows; interviewed 1,000+ candidates and trained 200+ employees; built executive Excel operating dashboards; configured PAR Brink, Maitre'D, and POSitouch POS pilots and delivered live POS demonstrations to prospective franchisees at corporate events.

## Education & Technical Stack

- **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Psychology (Minor in Biology), Purdue University through IUPUI (2020). Former Research Assistant across two IUPUI neuroscience laboratories (2011–2013); Geographic Researcher at HERE Technologies (2013–2016).
- **Languages & Web:** Python, JavaScript, React, SQL, HTML/CSS.
- **AI & Operations Stack:** Claude (Anthropic), Google Gemini, OpenAI, prompt engineering, non-hallucination guardrails, multi-model verification, Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS), Microsoft Dynamics 365, Jira, Five9, PAR Brink, Maitre'D, POSitouch, Excel financial and operating dashboards, VCarve Pro.
